patch_description:
Consolidate the ANSATZ_SPEC to use exactly 2 shared parameters instead of 3.
Currently: ry_shared, rz_pre_shared, rz_post_shared (20 params)
Target: ry_shared, rz_shared (only 3 params total, matching the best prior that scored 0.72)

This maximizes parameter sharing by reusing the same RZ parameter across both 
pre- and post-CZ layers. This reduces parameter count from 20 to 3, improving 
parameter_efficiency while maintaining full accuracy. The second prior program 
used this exact structure and achieved 0.72 vs current 0.68, so this should 
be an improvement.
